title: Send tool_choice auto once a forced tool has been called

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1063] Send `tool_choice: "auto"` from `Langchain::Assistant` once a forced tool (`"any"` or a function name) has been called since the latest user message, so a run with a forced tool can finish instead of calling the tool until `max_turns`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1064] Send `tool_choice: "none"` as the string `"none"` from the OpenAI and Mistral AI assistant adapters instead of a function named `none`, which the APIs rejected.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1062] Return the tool calls of every streamed chunk from `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` instead of only the last chunk's, which has none, so `Langchain::Assistant` runs tools with streaming on.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1061] Pass `max_completion_tokens` and `reasoning_effort` through `Langchain::LLM::OpenAI#chat` and `Langchain::LLM::Azure#chat` instead of dropping them; OpenAI's reasoning models reject `max_tokens`, so their output couldn't be capped.

@@ -349,12 +349,24 @@ def chat_with_llm
         instructions: @instructions,
         messages: array_of_message_hashes,
         tools: @tools,
-        tool_choice: tool_choice,
+        tool_choice: effective_tool_choice,
         parallel_tool_calls: parallel_tool_calls
       )
       @llm.chat(**params, &@block)
     end
 
+    # A forced tool_choice ("any" or a function name) makes every response call a tool, so a
+    # run could never reach a final answer. Once a tool has been called since the latest
+    # user message, the following requests use "auto".
+    #
+    # @return [String] The tool_choice to send with the next request
+    def effective_tool_choice
+      return tool_choice if ["auto", "none"].include?(tool_choice)
+
+      tool_called = messages.reverse_each.take_while { |message| !message.user? }.any? { |message| message.llm? && message.tool_calls.any? }
+      tool_called ? "auto" : tool_choice
+    end
+

     #
     # @param tool_calls [Array<Hash>] The tool calls to run

+        before do

+        end
+
+        it "forces the tool once, then sends auto so the run completes (see #825)" do
+          expect(subject.llm).to receive(:chat)
+            .with(hash_including(tool_choice: {"type" => "function", "function" => {"name" => "langchain_tool_calculator__execute"}}))
+            .ordered
+            .and_return(Langchain::LLM::Response::OpenAIResponse.new(raw_openai_response))
+          expect(subject.llm).to receive(:chat)
+            .with(hash_including(tool_choice: "auto"))
+            .ordered
+            .and_return(Langchain::LLM::Response::OpenAIResponse.new(raw_openai_final_response))
+
+          subject.add_message_and_run!(content: "Please calculate 2+2")
+
+          expect(subject.state).to eq(:completed)
+          expect(subject.messages.last.content).to eq("The result of 2 + 2 is 4.")
+          expect(subject.tool_choice).to eq("langchain_tool_calculator__execute")
+        end
+
+        it "forces the tool again for the next user message" do
+          subject.add_message(role: "user", content: "Please calculate 2+2")
+          subject.add_message(role: "assistant", tool_calls: raw_openai_response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"])
+          subject.add_message(role: "tool", content: "4.0", tool_call_id: "call_9TewGANaaIjzY31UCpAAGLeV")
+          subject.add_message(role: "assistant", content: "4")
+          subject.add_message(role: "user", content: "And 3+3?")
+
+          expect(subject.llm).to receive(:chat)
+            .with(hash_including(tool_choice: {"type" => "function", "function" => {"name" => "langchain_tool_calculator__execute"}}))
+            .and_return(Langchain::LLM::Response::OpenAIResponse.new(raw_openai_final_response))
+
+          subject.run
+        end
+      end
